feature: Stop while Ask's model is still loading
summary: Pressing Stop on a request while Ask is still getting its model ready now starts the request waiting behind it straight away. Before, the waiting one sat there until the load was over.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Ask's model must not be in memory yet: quit and reopen Photonz Dev, or leave Ask unused for a few minutes. Measured with ask-stops-a-running-request-walk on a cold model: before the fix it failed at the Stop (the second request still waiting 0.6 s later); after, all 40 steps passed in 129 s.

try.do: Open a blank picture and press Command-K.
Type "add a blue rectangle" and press Return while the Agent group says Getting the model ready.
Press Command-K again, type "add a red circle" and press Return: it waits under the first.
Press Stop on the blue rectangle.
Watch the red circle take over at once, still getting the model ready, then land.

evaluate: Does the red circle move up to working the moment you press Stop?
Does it carry on from the load already under way, rather than starting the wait over?
Does the finished history hold only the circle, with nothing of the stopped rectangle?
rough: Stop does not throw the load away: the request behind needs the same model, so the load keeps going and a stop with nothing waiting leaves the model loaded until the usual few idle minutes let it go.
No mock covers this surface; it is behaviour only, no layout changed.
